say:0:1011418001:0.text: So it really was the outsiders who brought the corruption...
say:0:1011418001:0.source_cn: 带来腐化的，果然是外来者……

say:1:1011418002:0.text: But the one who can cleanse the corruption is a friend from Holistone.
say:1:1011418002:0.source_cn: 但能净化腐化的，也是从圣石镇远赴而来的朋友。
say:1:1011418002:0.male: But the one who can cleanse the corruption is a friend from Holistone.
say:1:1011418002:0.female: But the one who can cleanse the corruption is a friend from Holistone.

say:2:1011418003:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> did cleanse the corruption. I saw it.
say:2:1011418003:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style> did cleanse the corruption. I saw it.
say:2:1011418003:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> did cleanse the corruption. I saw it.

say:3:1011418004:0.text: Yes... Outsiders can be both a threat and a source of hope.
say:3:1011418004:0.source_cn: 是的……外来之客，既可能是威胁，也可能是希望。
say:3:1011418004:0.male: Yes... Outsiders can be both a threat and a source of hope.
say:3:1011418004:0.female: Yes... Outsiders can be both a threat and a source of hope.
